name: Watch a page for new articles and email a digest with Gaffa

parameters.content:
## Watch a page for new articles and email a digest

### How it works
Point this workflow at any page that lists articles and get an email whenever new ones appear.

1. Set the page URL and the CSS selector of the article list in the Settings node.
2. The Gaffa node loads the page in a real browser and extracts every article as title, url and date.
3. The Keep only new articles node remembers the URLs it has seen and lets only new ones through.
4. New articles are formatted into one digest and sent by email.

### Setup
1. Install the Gaffa community node (@gaffa-dev/n8n-nodes-gaffa) if you have not already.
2. Create an API key at gaffa.dev and add it as the Gaffa API credential.
3. Add your SMTP credential and the from and to addresses in the Send the digest node.
4. Put your page URL and list selector into the Settings node, then activate the workflow.

### Customization tips
The seen URLs only persist in production runs, so a manual test run always emails the full list. Adjust the Schedule Trigger to how often the page updates. The selector narrows what the extraction reads, pick the element that wraps the article list, for example `#main` or `.post-list`.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json.page_url, max_cache_age: 0, settings: { time_limit: 60000, actions: [ { type: "parse_json", selector: $json.list_selector, output_type: "inline", data_schema: { name: "article_list", description: "The articles listed on the page", fields: [ { type: "array", name: "articles", description: "One entry per article in the list", fields: [ { type: "string", name: "title", description: "The article title" }, { type: "string", name: "url", description: "The absolute link to the article" }, { type: "string", name: "date", description: "The publication date or age as shown, empty string when the page shows none" } ] } ] } } ] } }) }}
